findings.observation: Consumed action, outcome or credit iterators could erase declarations; one reproduced draft reported a positive-credit zero-cost loop feasible.
findings.repair: Validate exact containers and record/value types before traversal; reject iterators without consuming them.

findings.observation: Colon concatenation could map distinct state/action pairs to the same label.
findings.repair: Canonical JSON-array components and strict label-kind/arity checks.

findings.observation: Boolean/integer model names were not consistently rejected.
findings.repair: Require exact nonempty strings and exact supported datatypes.
